faqs.question: Can I finance dental implants?
faqs.answer: Eligible applicants may apply through participating lending partners subject to credit assessment.

faqs.question: Does financing cover full-mouth implants?
faqs.answer: Loan amount depends on treatment cost and lender eligibility.

faqs.question: Which documents are required?
faqs.answer: PAN, Aadhaar, KYC and income proof may be required.

faqs.question: How long does approval take?
faqs.answer: Approval depends on lender verification and internal assessment.
